articles.author: SOCKET MOBILE, INC.
articles.headline: Socket Mobile Partners with 3Eye Technologies to Expand Industrial Mobility Solutions for Apple-Based Frontline Operations
articles.summary: Socket Mobile announced a distribution partnership with 3Eye Technologies for scanners, contactless readers and mobile data-capture products through North American channel partners.
